The Green Line Commuter Bike Bus

Raleigh, NC · Social · Mixed

Beginner friendly

The Green Line Commuter Bike Bus is a social group ride in Raleigh, NC. It rolls every Wednesday at 7:30 am from Lockwood Park. Pace: casual, around 12 mph, runs on a timetable.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at @oaksandspokes the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the The Green Line Commuter Bike Bus group ride

A group commute on a fixed timetable. It leaves Lockwood Park, follows the Crabtree Creek and House Creek greenways to NC State, and ends at Moore Square around 9 am. Hop on or off at any listed stop. The pace is casual but it keeps to the schedule, so it is technically a drop ride. A 2026 pilot.
